study_tier: ordinary-host exploratory correctness and stage-cost diagnostic; no Tier 0 or Tier 1 speedup gate
target_selection: preexisting non-direct public point from the frozen height-order census; reused during method development
lift_candidate_order: nonzero (a,b) in [-4,4]^2 sorted by Decimal quadratic height score,a,b; no precomputed rational candidates
lift_stop: first target lift with b=0, or both a target lift and an equal-reduction collision from two distinct rational candidates; derive R/G from the collision, then verify scalar multiplication
rho: Floyd rho on the same target with x-mod-3 walk partition, deterministic per-pair seeds and restart on degenerate collision, cap 10000 iterations per seed
timing: monotonic_ns starts before first target-dependent point operation and stops after scalar replay; process launch, curve construction, Q/R import, height pairing and coefficient sorting recorded as separate setup
resource: one process, one thread, no resource isolation or enforced memory cap; record host/runtime and raw pairs
claim_boundary: exploratory same-target timing on a reused 43-point input; no online speedup or extrapolation claim
